subject: Insurance
title: Comprehensive: Everything Else
description: A quick, practical guide to Comprehensive: Everything Else.

hook.text: A deer hits your car, hail dents the roof.

buildup.text: Comprehensive covers theft, vandalism, weather damage, falling objects, animal strikes, and fire.

discovery.text: The average comprehensive claim is $2,000—much less than collision.

twist.text: Deer strikes cause $10 billion in annual damage in the US.

climax.text: Comprehensive fills the gaps that liability and collision miss. It's cheap protection against the unpredictable.

punchline.text: Deer, hail, theft, fire. Comprehensive covers everything a collision doesn't.

quiz.question: What does comprehensive coverage protect against?
options: Non-collision events like theft, weather, and animal strikes
